The proposed _EXPECTED_CLIENT_AUTH_ERROR_TERMS mixes message fragments with gotrue CODES, but on the pinned supabase-auth 2.31.0 str(AuthApiError) is the message only -- 'refresh_token_not_found', 'invalid_credentials', 'invalid_grant', 'bad_jwt', 'session_not_found', 'email_exists', 'weak_password', 'same_password', 'validation_failed', 'otp_expired' can only ever match a status-less plain Exception whose text happens to spell them. Also 'invalid login credentials', 'user already registered', 'email not confirmed' are unreachable in the generic branch (the early returns fire first). Every real SDK exception carries .status, so the status rule decides them; the tuple matters only for status-less exceptions (notably complete_password_recovery, which re-wraps as Exception(str(e))). Measured messages the tuple must cover for that path: 'invalid refresh token', 'refresh token not found', 'already used', 'invalid jwt' (and 'token is expired' if expiry text without 'invalid jwt' matters -- the spec's 'token has expired' does not match gotrue's 'token is expired').
